prolongedPdpStay.agentMessageNew:
The user has spent time on this product and may need help deciding.

- Share ONE non-obvious detail that could help with their decision (feature, durability, review insight, or usage detail).
- Ask ONE focused follow-up question or suggest a comparison.

Do not repeat information already obvious on the page. Do not restate the product name at the beginning. Keep the response concise and decision-focused.

sizeConfusion.agentMessage: Help the user with sizing for {{product}}. Show the size chart ONLY if one is available; otherwise list the available sizes. Ask one fit question.
sizeConfusion._agentMessage.comment: Internal instruction for the AI agent on how to help with sizing questions. {Placeholder="{{product}}"} should not be translated
sizeConfusion.agentMessageNew:
The user wants help with sizing for {product}.

If a size chart is available:
- Show the size chart inline.
- Ask ONE follow-up question focused on the most relevant fit dimension (e.g., chest, waist, length).
- Do not recommend a size yet.

If no size chart is available:
- List available sizes.
- Clearly state that measurement guidance is not available for this product.
- Offer one helpful next step (e.g., similar product with size chart or return policy).
- Do not suggest a size based on measurements.

Keep the response concise, practical, and easy to scan.
sizeConfusion._agentMessageNew.comment: New copy variant of the internal instruction for the AI agent to resolve sizing confusion by recommending an appropriate size. {Placeholder="{{product}}"} should not be translated

frustrationScore.agentMessageNew:
The user appears to be having trouble, but the issue is unclear.

- Acknowledge the situation in one short, neutral sentence.
- Ask ONE specific question to clarify what they need (e.g., deciding, finding something different, or checking details).
- Stop after the question.

Do not list capabilities. Do not recommend products yet. Keep the response concise and focused on helping the user take the next step.

productComparison.agentMessageNew:
The user is comparing multiple products.

- Highlight 2-3 key differences that matter for choosing between them (features, price, or use cases).
- Call out one meaningful tradeoff.
- Ask ONE question to help narrow the decision.

Keep the comparison easy to scan. Do not list every detail. Focus on helping the user choose.

colorConfusion.agentMessageNew:

websiteAbandonment.nudgeMessage: Still deciding? I can help narrow it down.
websiteAbandonment._nudgeMessage.comment: Proactive message shown when Clarity detects the user is about to disengage from the session (frustration, idle, tab switch, or aimless browsing). Page-agnostic - fires on any page type. Frames the moment as hesitation (not exit-intent) to stay assistive rather than promotional.
websiteAbandonment.nudgeMessageNew: Still deciding? I can help narrow it down.
websiteAbandonment._nudgeMessageNew.comment: New copy variant of the proactive message shown on website abandonment signals. Reflects shopper state (deciding), not system state.
websiteAbandonment._mobileNudgeMessage.comment: Short mobile-friendly version of the proactive message shown on website abandonment signals.
websiteAbandonment.chatMessage: I'm not sure what to get — can you help me decide?
websiteAbandonment._chatMessage.comment: User-facing message that appears in the chat when the abandonment signal nudge is activated. Expresses a single decision-help intent.
websiteAbandonment.chatMessageNew: I'm not sure what to get — can you help me decide?
websiteAbandonment._chatMessageNew.comment: New copy variant of the user-facing message expressing a single decision-help intent.
websiteAbandonment.agentMessage:
The user is showing signs of leaving the session — treat this as a hesitation moment, not a confirmed exit.

- Open with one short, warm sentence that acknowledges they may still be deciding. Do not assume the cause. Do not use exit-intent language ("wait", "before you go", "don't leave", "are you sure").
- Ask ONE focused question to surface what's actually blocking them (e.g., still deciding, looking for something specific, or checking a detail).
- Stop after the question.

Do not list capabilities. Do not recommend products yet. Do not reference time on page or any underlying signal. Keep the response under two short lines.
websiteAbandonment._agentMessage.comment: Internal instruction for the AI agent on how to respond when Clarity detects the user is about to disengage. Page-agnostic - no product reference. Forbids exit-intent phrasing.
websiteAbandonment.agentMessageNew:

- Open with one short, warm sentence that acknowledges they may still be deciding. Do not assume the cause. Do not use exit-intent language ("wait", "before you go", "don't leave", "are you sure").
- Ask ONE focused question to surface what's actually blocking them (e.g., still deciding, looking for something specific, or checking a detail).
- Stop after the question.

Do not list capabilities. Do not recommend products yet. Do not reference time on page or any underlying signal. Keep the response under two short lines.
websiteAbandonment._agentMessageNew.comment: New copy variant of the internal instruction for the AI agent to retain users showing disengagement signals without being pushy. Page-agnostic.
